description.en: The ID of the IPAM pool allocation.

description.zh:
IPAM地址池CIDR分配所属IPAM Pool的所在地域。

> 当IPAM地址池CIDR分配所属IPAM Pool具备地域属性时，该属性为IPAM Pool的所在地域。当IPAM地址池CIDR分配所属IPAM Pool不具备地域属性时，该属性为IPAM托管地域。
description.en:
The region of the IPAM pool to which the CIDR block allocation belongs.

> If the IPAM pool has a region attribute, this parameter specifies the region of the IPAM pool. If the IPAM pool does not have a region attribute, this parameter specifies the managed region of IPAM.

title.zh: 查询指定IPAM地址池CIDR分配的信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpcipam get-ipam-pool-allocation --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipam-pool-allocation-id ipam-pool-alloc-112za33e40000 --region cn-hangzhou
